ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners against the Bermuda Consolidated Sanctions List, UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) list, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, United Nations Security Council sanctions list, and EU restrictive measures. Enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons, family members, and close associates; source-of-funds verification required for capital injections and engineering outsourcing contract proceeds; continuous transaction monitoring and regulatory reporting to the Bermuda Financial Intelligence Agency.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Registry Portal (Companies e-Services / CSD Online)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be registered in Latin script; non-Latin scripts require an approved English transliteration. The corporate name must include a statutory suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'PCC Limited', or 'LLC' for exempted companies. Chinese characters and Arabic script are not permitted in the official registered name; any foreign-language trading name must be filed as an approved alternate business name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Filing party must submit a written objection and appeal through the e-Registry portal naming the proposed corporate name as a header, together with a nullification fee of BMD 50 within 14 calendar days of the refusal notice. The Registrar of Companies must issue a determination within 21 working days. If the Registrar maintains the rejection, the applicant may appeal to the Supreme Court of Bermuda under section 15A of the Companies Act 1981.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not acceptable as the statutory registered office. Every exempted company must maintain a physical registered office address in Bermuda where legal process may be served. A Bermuda corporate services provider may act as registered office agent and offer administrative office support, but the address must be a real street address with staff able to accept service of process during normal business hours.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate. Unannounced on-site inspection risk for an engineering CAD outsourcing exempted company is quantified at 15% in the first year, rising to 40% where adverse PEP, sanctions, or suspicious transaction indicators emerge. The Registrar of Companies may inspect the registered office under the Companies Act; the Bermuda Monetary Authority may conduct AML/CFT site visits under the Proceeds of Crime Regulations.

incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Companies Section, Ministry of Finance, 53 Church Street, Hamilton, Bermuda)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association (Form 1A for Exempted Companies) and Articles of Association filed under s. 4(1); Certificate of Incorporation issued under s. 7(1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Companies Act 1981; subscriber shares may be issued fully paid or partly paid as set out in the Articles; no escrow or mandatory paid-up deposit regime applies to exempted companies

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Exempted Undertaking Tax Protection Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies and Ministry of Finance (Companies Authorization Unit), Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name (suffix 'Limited' mandatory) for reservation via the licensed corporate service provider using the official name clearance portal or paper application at the Companies Registry. Simultaneously apply to the Ministry of Finance for a permit to establish an exempted undertaking, which affords exchange control and tax protection. The name must not be undesirable, conflict with existing entities, or imply a regulated activity (e.g., banking, insurance) unless separately licensed.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Proposed exempted company name and ISIC business description
Certificate of Exempted Undertaking application (Ministry of Finance)
Letter of engagement from licensed Bermuda corporate service provider
Identity documents of ultimate beneficial owners (notarized)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, submit a fresh reservation with up to three alternative names; any comment from the Registrar shall be cured by amending the memorandum of association name clause and resubmitting within 14 days of the notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Subscriber (incorporator) and corporate legal counsel admitted in Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association on Form 1A (exempted company format) stating the registered office clause, share capital clause (authorized US$12,000 divided into 1,200,000 shares of US$0.01 each), purpose clause permitting offshore CAD/BIM engineering consultancy, and adoption of the standard or customized Articles of Association. Execute the documents before a notary public or witness; print on legal paper and affix any required company common seal where adopted. The subscriber must sign alongside the Bermuda registered agent's signature block.
required_dossiers: Form 1A - Memorandum of Association (executed)
Articles of Association (executed)
Subscriber's proof of identity and address (notarized)
Consent of first director (Form 10 draft)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar requests amendments to the objects or share capital clauses, execute supplemental deed of accession or file a revised memorandum with a cover letter addressing the requisition; no re-notarization required if the revision is limited to clerical corrections endorsed by counsel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Payment of Incorporation Fees to the Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (filing counter and e-registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the executed Form 1A, Articles of Association, and associated consents to the Registrar of Companies through the licensed corporate service provider. Pay the statutory incorporation fee of BMD 1,295 plus Ministry of Finance processing fee of BMD 350 (total BMD 1,645) by bank draft or registry-approved electronic transfer. The filing must include a certificate of the registered agent confirming compliance with the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008.
required_dossiers: Executed Form 1A (Memorandum of Association)
Executed Articles of Association
Registered agent certificate of compliance (AML/ATF)
Form of consent to act as resident representative
Fee payment authorization (BMD 1,645)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for correction, the registered agent shall submit a letter of correction with the amended page(s) within 7 days of the requisition; any requisition notice is automatically deemed satisfied where the defect is cured within the statutory 14-day window without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Tax Exemption Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies and Ministry of Finance, Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation evidencing corporate existence and limited liability. Concurrently, the Ministry of Finance grants the Certificate of Exempted Undertaking under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, which guarantees that no Bermuda taxes on income, profits, dividends, or capital gains shall apply until at least 2035 and in any event not beyond 2059 for existing exempted companies. Upload the certificate to the company's statutory records and obtain certified copies for bank onboarding.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued)
Exempted Undertaking Tax Protection Certificate (issued)
Memorandum and Articles as stamped by the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any typographical error in the Certificate shall be corrected by filing a formal rectification request with the Registrar under s. 14A Companies Act 1981; no fee is levied for a Registrar-discretionary correction where the error originates from the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Resident Representative Appointment and Beneficial Ownership Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies (Beneficial Ownership Secure Search System - BOSS) and BMA-supervised corporate services providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a resident representative who is either a Bermuda-resident individual, licensed incorporated segregated accounts company, or registered entity satisfying the eligibility criteria under s. 8A of the Companies Act 1981, and file the executed consent with the Registrar. File the Beneficial Ownership declaration within 21 days of incorporation, disclosing each registrable beneficial owner's full legal name, date of birth, nationality, and service address; the BOSS system records remain accessible only to the Registrar, police, and financial intelligence unit.
required_dossiers: Consent of resident representative (Form under Companies Act s. 8A)
Beneficial ownership register declaration
PEP (politically exposed person) screening report
Passport copies of all shareholders holding >10%
Registered agent confirmation of source of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the beneficial ownership return is rejected, the registered agent shall file a corrected return within 48 hours; late or defective returns attract a fixed penalty regime, but a first-time correction notice may be cured without penalty where filed within the registrar's grace period of 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office Confirmation, Officer Filings and Ancillary Administrative Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Forms 10 and 14); Department of Social Insurance (SS-1); Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service (if leasing physical premises)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 14 (Notice of Registered Office) confirming the location of the registered office within Bermuda, to be maintained by the licensed corporate services provider. File Form 10 (Notice of Directors and Officers) listing the first director, president, secretary, and treasurer. If the company leases a serviced office, obtain a Fire Safety Certificate and Occupancy Permit from the building management/Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service; register as an employer with the Department of Social Insurance by filing Form SS-1 prior to hiring any Bermuda resident staff.
required_dossiers: Form 14 - Notice of Registered Office
Form 10 - Notice of Directors and Officers
Consents to act of each officer
Lease or occupier consent for physical workspace
Form SS-1 (Social Insurance employer registration, where applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to maintain a registered office is an offence; cure by immediately notifying the Registrar of any change using Form 14 within 30 days of relocation. If the social insurance registration is queried, furnish the certificate of incorporation and officer list to the Department of Social Insurance within 5 business days to regularize the record.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Workforce Solutions - Trade Licensing Authority, Government of Bermuda (applicable only if the company maintains a physical commercial presence undertaking local business; not applicable to pure offshore CAD/BIM services)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category E (no physical project footprint, no land disturbance, zero manufacturing discharge); full EIA and environmental permit not triggered for digital professional services
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater, VOC, or particulate emissions generated by office-based CAD operations; any electronic waste (WEEE) must be disposed of through a DENR-approved recycler under the Waste Management Regulations 2018; stormwater and sanitary discharges from leased premises remain the landlord's obligation under the Clean Air and Water Act 1972

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service under the Fire Safety Act 2015 for any leased premises; Building Occupancy Permit from the Department of Planning confirming structural load and egress compliance; workplace approval from the Department of Workforce Solutions (Workplace Health and Safety) where employees occupy the premises; no high-risk industrial clearance required for clerical drafting operations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Ministry of Finance: Office of the Tax Commissioner (payroll tax, stamp duty, customs duty) and the Registry General: Registrar of Companies (incorporation, economic substance, beneficial ownership). Primary portal: www.gov.bm; corporate filings portal: www.registry.gov.bm. No income-tax or VAT authority exists because Bermuda levies no such taxes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Bermuda does not issue a general corporate income-tax TIN or VAT ID. A Bermuda Exempted Company obtains its statutory identity by: (i) incorporating through a licensed Bermuda law firm or corporate services provider under the Companies Act 1981; (ii) receiving the Certificate of Incorporation, which bears the unique Company Registration Number used as the operative TIN for CRS/AEOI, banking and contractual purposes; (iii) filing the Declaration of Status and completing the Beneficial Ownership Register filings with the Registrar of Companies; and (iv) registering for an Employer Payroll Tax Account with the Office of the Tax Commissioner only if the company has Bermuda-resident employees. If the entity is in scope of the Economic Substance Act 2018, an annual Economic Substance Return is filed via the Registry General portal. No other tax registration is required for a purely offshore CAD/BIM service exporter.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Bermuda has no US-style check-the-box election and no hybrid-mismatch election because it imposes no corporate income tax. Available statutory mechanisms include: (i) the non-resident entity election under the Economic Substance Act 2018, whereby a company that is tax resident in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction can be treated as non-resident in Bermuda, replacing the Bermuda economic substance filing with a supported foreign tax residence representation; (ii) an application for a Certificate of Tax Residence or tax exemption confirmation under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, which protects the company from future Bermuda taxes on income, profits, dividends and capital gains until 2035 (or 2057 for grandfathered undertakings); and (iii) CRS/FATCA self-classification using the Bermuda Company Registration Number as the tax identification number.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No comprehensive VAT, GST or sales-and-use tax. Bermuda imposes customs import duties under the Customs Tariff Act, employer payroll tax under the Payroll Tax Act 1995, and stamp duties on specified instruments and land transactions. Cross-border services supplies are outside any Bermuda indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: there is no VAT/GST registration threshold for services. Customs registration is triggered only for physical imports into Bermuda. Payroll tax registration is compulsory for any employer of Bermuda-resident staff with no de minimis turnover threshold; the employer payroll tax rate ranges from 0% to 11.7% of total remuneration depending on payroll size, levied in Bermudian dollars (BMD, pegged 1:1 to USD). For the ISIC 7110 BIM/CAD export model with no Bermuda-resident employees and no physical imports, no indirect-tax or payroll registration is triggered.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Bermuda does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, electronic invoice clearance, digital stamping or API-based tax reporting for commercial invoices. Invoices are governed by ordinary commercial law and Companies Act 1981 record-keeping requirements (six-year retention). Where the Bermuda company invoices EU or UK clients, it must separately satisfy the counterparty jurisdiction's e-invoicing or Making Tax Digital obligations, but no Bermuda fiscal clearance applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: Bermuda has no VAT or sales tax, so there is no 0% export VAT rate, no export VAT refund mechanism and no zero-rating claim procedure. Cross-border CAD/BIM services supplied by a Bermuda Exempted Company are outside the Bermuda tax net ab initio: no corporate income tax, no profit or remittance tax, and no withholding tax on royalties, interest or service fees. To preserve the exempt-zone posture and support international invoicing, the company should maintain a current Certificate of Incorporation, file any applicable Economic Substance Return (demonstrating that it is not a passive shell), and obtain, where needed, a Certificate of Tax Residence from the Bermuda Ministry of Finance. The 180-day FX repatriation benchmark in this dossier is an internal treasury policy only, because Bermuda imposes no exchange controls and no statutory profit repatriation deadline.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable for cross-border services: no export VAT documentation is required by Bermuda. For the service contract substantiation bundle, maintain: executed Services Agreement (ISIC 7110 BIM/engineering scope), milestone completion certificates, client acceptance sign-off, and the Bermuda Company Registration Number on all invoices and CRS self-certifications.

For any physical movement of prototypes, sample equipment or engineering hardware, Bermuda Customs clearance requires: Commercial Invoice in BMD or USD, packing list, Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, Bermuda Customs Export/Transshipment Declaration (form C-E64), insurance certificate, and the Exempted Company's Certificate of Incorporation.
For inbound settlement evidence: SWIFT MT103 or bank credit advice showing receipt of export service proceeds from the foreign client.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback or export zero-rating fraud penalties can apply because Bermuda has no VAT. The relevant compliance risks for the exempted company are: (i) Economic Substance Act 2018: failure to file or materially false filing of the Economic Substance Return attracts civil penalties up to BMD 10,000 plus BMD 1,000 per day of continued default and, on conviction, imprisonment up to 2 years; (ii) Companies Act 1981 and Beneficial Ownership Act: false incorporation declarations or deficient beneficial-ownership records carry penalties up to BMD 10,000 and possible strike-off with loss of limited liability; (iii) CRS/FATCA self-certification misstatements can attract penalties up to BMD 10,000 per instance and enhanced AML reviews; (iv) payroll tax misdeclarations, if Bermuda-resident employees are later discovered, carry interest of 10-20%, penalties up to 100% of the tax due, and potential director liability. Any clawback is therefore civil-administrative in nature rather than a VAT refund recapture.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) — integrated financial regulator, central monetary authority and sole issuer of the Bermudian dollar
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Bermuda operates a liberalised exchange control regime under the Exchange Control Act 1972. The Bermudian dollar is pegged at par to the US dollar. For Bermuda exempted companies, the BMA grants blanket or transaction-specific exchange control permissions enabling free convertibility for both current account and capital account transactions. Profit remittances, dividend distributions and liquidation proceeds can be remitted to non-resident shareholders without material restriction, subject only to compliance with corporate law formalities and standard know-your-customer obligations. Practical friction may arise in the form of documentary burdens and bank-level compliance reviews rather than statutory convertibility hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Bermuda imposes no statutory surrender requirements, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no repatriation timelines for export proceeds. A Bermudian exempted company carrying on international BIM and CAD services may retain all export receipts in any foreign currency indefinitely. The only relevant obligations are exchange control reporting obligations to the BMA under the Exchange Control Act, which are typically satisfied through banking channels and do not require conversion into Bermudian dollars.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium. Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer and Mercury can be used for low-value ancillary disbursements and to receive certain overseas client payments. However, they are not a substitute for a licensed Bermuda bank account for capital escrow, trade settlement, or regulatory evidentiary purposes. Legal constraints include the absence of a Bermuda EMI licence for such platforms, the lack of Bermudian dollar clearing, reliance on foreign e-money licences, the lack of deposit insurance, and potential restrictions on holding funds for corporate treasury purposes. For a Bermuda exempted company, the primary cross-border clearing rail should be a domestic commercial bank account with a US correspondent banking relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a non-resident-owned Bermuda exempted company engaged in offshore BIM/CAD outsourcing, physical attendance by directors and ultimate beneficial owners is generally not mandatory. Most Bermuda commercial banks permit fully remote onboarding through video-conference identification, electronic signature, and submission of notarised corporate documents. The bank will require the licensed Bermuda registered agent to provide a certified certificate of incorporation, register of directors and shareholders, memorandum of association, and a corporate informational return. Financial crime compliance committees reserve the right to require a physical or virtual interview where the UBO resides in a FATF-high-risk jurisdiction, where the source of wealth cannot be clearly evidenced, or where the transaction profile indicates high counterparty or jurisdictional risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner located in a high-risk or sanctioned jurisdiction, or passport issued by a country with weak AML enforcement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised proof of identity and address; professional reference letters from a regulated financial institution or legal counsel; source-of-wealth declaration supported by audited financial statements, tax records, bank references, and third-party background screening reports; corporate organogram showing the full UBO chain and a clear explanation of the commercial rationale for the Bermuda structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Injection of initial capital from an unrelated third party or a jurisdiction lacking transparency, where the economic substance of the shareholder is unclear
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder resolution approving the capital contribution; bank statements of the investing entity; audited group accounts; holding structure diagram; copies of the underlying client contract for BIM services; AML/KYC clearance of the sender; and a sworn affidavit from the source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound payments to engineering subcontractors or procurement vendors before commencement of meaningful operational activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed subcontractor agreements; detailed invoices matching project scope; BIM project schedules and milestone deliverables; timesheets and model delivery logs; correspondence from the end-client; and a cash-flow forecast corroborating the disbursement urgency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fast round-tripping of received trade proceeds to offshore personal accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Memorialised treasury policy; board resolutions authorising disbursements; contracts and delivery evidence; intercompany lending agreements; bank fee payment evidence; and financial statements demonstrating that the emissary receives proceeds as consideration for bona fide services.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inward capital injections to a Bermuda exempted company should be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the company's Bermuda commercial bank account. The remittance instruction must include the company's full name, account number, and a purpose code clearly identifying the transaction as either 'Equity Injection' or 'Shareholder Subordinated Loan'. For US-dollar funding through the Bermudian bank's US correspondent, settlement occurs via CHIPS or Fedwire; for UK or European funding, the MT103 may be cleared through the local correspondent network in US dollars or converted into Bermudian dollars at the bank's prevailing FX desk. Pre-advice and a copy of the board resolution or share allotment notice may be requested for amounts above USD 100,000 to satisfy Bermuda's exchange control reporting and AML verification obligations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational outflows related to civil infrastructure BIM outsourcing, the primary clearing rail is the SWIFT MT103 wire transfer for invoices under commercial thresholds, with immediate funds settlement via the bank's international correspondent network. Larger project milestone payments may be effected through a Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) issued by the Bermuda bank, advised through a confirming bank in the beneficiary's jurisdiction, particularly for procurement of construction software or cloud services. For recurring subscription disbursements (e.g., CAD software licences, cloud hosting) a standing order via SWIFT or an open-banking API-enabled virtual account is permissible. All outbound trade disbursements require the recipient's bank details, invoice substantiation, and a valid purpose code; transactions exceeding USD 50,000 may trigger enhanced due diligence and a written description of the commercial services.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency forwards up to 12 months with BMA-licensed or permitted banks, hedging Bermudian-dollar/US-dollar export billings
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) through international dealers where physical settlement is unnecessary or prohibited by currency delivery constraints
Cross-currency swaps with BMA-regulated domestic banks or international counterparties under an ISDA Master Agreement and approved by the treasury risk committee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 September following the end of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of BMD 225 for first offence; repeated non-filing may lead to administrative penalties and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 60 days of the anniversary of incorporation (aligned with Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to BMD 5,000 for failure to file or maintain accurate beneficial ownership register.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory audit for ordinary exempted companies unless regulated (e.g., insurance, banking, investment funds) or shareholders holding at least 10% of voting shares request an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) commonly adopted; US GAAP or other standards may be used if approved by shareholders. Financial statements are not required to be filed publicly.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All shareholding transfers must be promptly recorded in the Register of Members; the Register of Beneficial Ownership must be updated and confirmed annually to the Registrar, identifying any beneficial owner holding 25% or more of shares.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; voluntary audit typically USD 7,000 - USD 18,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for all Bermuda Exempted Companies under the territorial exemption; a 15% corporate income tax applies exclusively to in-scope multinational enterprise groups (consolidated revenue of €750 million or more in at least two of the four preceding fiscal years) under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, including the 15% Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax for Bermuda-resident constituent entities.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 guarantees freedom from any future Bermudian tax on income, profits, capital gains, dividends or distributions until 31 March 2035; no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no VAT/GST; the only material imposts are payroll tax, employer social insurance contributions, customs duties and annual registration fees; CIT/QDMTT payable (where in scope) is creditable against GloBE top-up tax in other jurisdictions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ESR Declaration / Economic Substance (Requirements and Conformity) Act 2018 Annual Return — filed via the Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Services portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the financial year end (31 January for calendar-year entities)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda Registration Number (BRN), legal name, registered office, date of incorporation and financial year end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact BRN as shown in the Register of Companies; no UK HMRC reference is required for Bermudian filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare whether the entity conducts a 'relevant activity' under the ESR Act (e.g. distribution and service business, IP holding, headquarters) or is a pure equity holding entity / excluded business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border BIM/CAD outsourcing performed for UK or foreign group entities is generally a 'service business'; if the entity is tax resident outside Bermuda, claim the foreign-resident exclusion and attach the foreign tax residency determination.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report full-time employees in Bermuda, operating expenditure incurred in Bermuda, and the location where core income-generating activities (CIGAs) are directed and managed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document actual in-Bermuda board meetings and management decisions; nominee directorship without real control is a fatal red flag for ESR compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State total gross income derived from the relevant activity in the financial year, expressed in Bermuda dollars.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Convert the engineering/BIM services revenue at the BRA prevailing exchange rate and retain the source contracts for audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: BMD 500 plus escalating monthly surcharges; substantive ESR default: penalties up to BMD 250,000 per relevant activity year; repeated default triggers mandatory information exchange with HMRC and potential strike-off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Companies Act 1981 Annual Return (Exempted Company) — Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Services portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the anniversary of incorporation, with a grace period before the 10% monthly late-fee accrues

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office, exempted company status, tax protection certificate number under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the UK parent does not require a Bermuda tax number; the tax protection certificate references the exempted undertaking status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule B — Shareholders and share capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital, classes of shares, and current shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident (UK) beneficial ownership is permitted without exchange-control approval; mirror identical data in the Beneficial Ownership (BO) register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses and nationalities of all directors and officers; confirmation of consent to act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: UK-based directors may sit on the board, but ESR requires that direction and management materially occur in Bermuda for Bermuda tax-resident entities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual fee: penalty of 10% per month or part-month (capped at 50% of the annual fee); persistent non-filing leads to strike-off, dissolution and restoration costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Return — Bermuda Revenue Authority (BRA) digital portal (applicable only to in-scope MNE groups under CIT Act 2023)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 months after the end of the fiscal year, with a transitional 18-month extended deadline for the first assessment period (fiscal years commencing on or after 1 January 2025)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part 1 — Group and constituent entity identification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate parent entity (UPE) jurisdiction, GloBE identifier, constituent entity registration, and confirmation of the €750 million revenue threshold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a UK-parented group, identify the United Kingdom as the UPE jurisdiction and confirm whether the UK will file the GloBE Information Return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part 2 — Covered taxes and effective tax rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of covered taxes, GloBE income or loss, effective tax rate and top-up tax percentage for Bermuda constituent entities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the OECD Pillar Two GloBE model rules; include the Bermuda QDMTT calculation for resident entities to avoid double top-up.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of intercompany transactions with UK/EU affiliates, including the method applied and the arm's length outcome.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Align the disclosure with the UK group's TP policy; a cost-plus or TNMM method is usual for BIM/CAD outsourcing services.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file: fixed penalty plus monthly accrual of 5% of unpaid tax (capped at 25%); late payment interest at the statutory rate; inaccurate returns attract up to 150% of understated tax; criminal liability for deliberate evasion.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Payroll Tax Return (Employer Monthly Return) — Bermuda Revenue Authority payroll portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 15th day of the month following the payroll period

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payroll tax account number, company BRN and payroll period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Required only if the exempted company employs staff in Bermuda; remote UK employees are not subject to Bermuda payroll tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross emoluments, exempt allowances, payroll tax bands (10.5% / 13% / 21.5% per the progressive scale) and social insurance contributions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retained in-Bermuda staff must be genuinely remunerated through Bermuda payroll; paying them from the UK without a payroll reversal is a substance and AML red flag.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and payment: 10% penalty on the unpaid tax plus statutory interest; continued default triggers enforcement, director personal liability and disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Bermuda imposes no withholding tax on dividends, distributions or liquidation surpluses paid by an Exempted Company to its UK or any foreign shareholder.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda is not party to any comprehensive double taxation agreement; only the UK–Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2007) applies. To secure the statutory exemption from future Bermudian taxes, the entity must hold a tax protection certificate issued by the Ministry of Finance under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966. To evidence Bermudian tax residency for foreign tax credit purposes (e.g. UK controlled-foreign-company or inbound credit computations), the company applies to the Bermuda Revenue Authority for a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC); UK shareholders rely on the UK dividend exemption under CTA 2009 ss. 931A–931I rather than any DTA relief. No withholding-tax reclaim procedure exists because no domestic WHT is levied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax: 0% on both cross-border royalties (including licence fees for CAD/BIM software and intellectual property) and interest on intercompany or third-party debt paid by a Bermuda Exempted Company. Treaty rates: not applicable due to the absence of a DTA; the UK recipient of royalties or interest remains taxable in the UK under domestic corporation tax and UK transfer-pricing rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No mandatory Bermuda Local File or Master File applies to a standalone exempted company outside OECD Pillar Two scope. Mandatory OECD-conformant transfer pricing documentation and CIT disclosure attach only where the multinational group's consolidated revenue equals or exceeds €750 million (approximately BMD 750 million) in at least two of the four preceding fiscal years, triggering the CIT Act 2023 TP rules.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance (Requirements and Conformity) Act 2018 requires every Bermuda tax-resident entity carrying on a relevant activity to maintain substantial economic presence in Bermuda: direction and management in Bermuda, adequate full-time employees, adequate operating expenditure, and physical premises. Cross-border BIM/CAD engineering outsourcing for UK/EU clients normally constitutes a 'service business' (relevant activity) when performed for related parties; pure equity holding entities benefit from reduced substance requirements. Entities tax resident outside Bermuda may claim exclusion only with foreign tax residency evidence. Non-compliance exposes the entity to penalties up to BMD 250,000 per relevant activity year, mandatory exchange of information with HMRC, and loss of tax-exempt standing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming Bermuda tax-exempt status while conducting the BIM/CAD service business entirely from the UK with no Bermuda employees, expenditure, premises or in-Bermuda board control; filing a false ESR declaration; or operating purely as a passive invoice conduit for UK engineering fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the ESR Act: penalty up to BMD 250,000 per relevant activity year plus monthly default penalties; mandatory automatic exchange of information with UK HMRC; denial of the foreign-resident exclusion; eventual strike-off and dissolution of the exempted company by the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who approve false ESR declarations or cause the company to trade without substance are jointly and severally liable for the penalty debt; may be disqualified as directors; subject to injunctions and asset-freeze orders; in aggravated cases, criminal prosecution for fraud on the Register.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (in-scope groups)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a false CIT/QDMTT return, omitting GloBE income, destroying records, or colluding with the UK parent to shift profit out of Bermuda to a no-tax jurisdiction in breach of the CIT Act 2023.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to 150% of the understated tax, fixed penalties for failure to file or keep records (up to BMD 50,000–250,000), monthly 5% surcharge on unpaid tax (capped at 25%), statutory interest, and criminal fines on conviction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers and controlling minds are personally exposed to civil recovery, director disqualification orders, travel restrictions and imprisonment for deliberate evasion, and may be pursued by the BRA for the unpaid penalty without the benefit of corporate indemnity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abuse of Exempted Undertaking Tax Protection certificate
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the 1966 Act tax protection certificate to shelter income that is in substance UK-source engineering income, misstating the scope of protected activities, or engaging in a business activity outside the terms of the granted certificate without notifying the Ministry of Finance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation or variation of the tax protection certificate; imposition of Bermudian taxes on the unprotected business retroactively; financial penalties and costs; administrative strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations in support of the certificate face personal penalty assessments, restitution orders for taxes avoided, and potential criminal liability for furnishing false information to a public authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving client or intercompany payments for civil infrastructure projects without customer due diligence, politically exposed person screening, or suspicious transaction reporting; processing bribery or kickback proceeds linked to public procurement tenders through the Bermuda account; operating under the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 without a compliance regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997: fines and imprisonment up to 14 years for money laundering; regulatory sanctions by the Bermuda Monetary Authority and the Financial Intelligence Agency; confiscation and asset forfeiture orders; closure of the Bermuda bank accounts and correspondent banking loss.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers and beneficial owners bear personal criminal liability, are subject to worldwide travel bans, asset confiscation and extradition exposure, and may be barred from acting as directors of any Bermudian company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Persistent filing default and trading while struck off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the annual Companies Act return, the ESR declaration, payroll returns, or CIT/QDMTT returns after repeated statutory notices; continuing to invoice clients after the Registrar has struck the exempted company off the register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic late-filing penalties (10% per month on annual fees; BMD 500 and monthly surcharges on ESR filings); strike-off and dissolution; restoration only by court order with penal costs; the struck-off company's contracts and assets vest in the Registrar as bona vacantia.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who trade through a struck-off company are jointly and severally liable for all debts incurred after dissolution, may be disqualified by the court, fined, and in egregious cases prosecuted for fraudulent trading under the Companies Act 1981 and the Criminal Code.
